name: Chikan Densha ~Oyaji Chi*po ni Okasarete Teikou Dekinai~
original_name: 痴漢電車～オヤジチ○ポに犯されて抵抗できない～
source:
A man who bought "time-stopping medicine" uses it to get off with a pretty girl on the train.

The time-stopping idea comes from Jojo.

One word of caution: don't hurt yourself jacking off! :)

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142230.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一個買到「時間停止藥」的男人，用它對電車上的漂亮女孩發洩性慾。

時間停止的創意來自《JOJO的奇妙冒險》。

提醒一句，自慰時可別傷到自己！:)
